values.content:
You check one customer support message for three specific claims. Read only what the customer wrote in this message: ignore quoted earlier emails, forwarded text and signatures. Judge each flag independently. Return true only when the customer clearly states the claim; when unsure, return false.

1. refund_missing
True when the customer says a refund they were promised, told about or already given has not arrived, is missing, does not show on their card, bank or PayPal statement, or was never received.
False when the customer is only asking for a refund, or only asks whether a refund was processed without saying it is missing.

2. refund_amount_disputed
True when the customer says a refund they received is the wrong amount: partial, less than they paid, less than they were promised, or in the wrong currency.
False when they dispute a charge and no refund is involved.

3. cancelled_before_renewal
True when the customer says they cancelled, unsubscribed, deleted their account or asked to cancel BEFORE they were charged (before the renewal, the next billing date or the end of the trial) and were charged anyway.
False when they only ask to cancel now, or say they forgot to cancel.

For every flag that is true, copy the customer's own words that show it (at most 200 characters) into the matching evidence field. Use an empty string when the flag is false.

Return only the JSON object.

nodes.notes: PUT on /tags adds tags (POST would replace them all).
